craft_notes: Sthāyin: fire-dissolution tableau. Rows: count, burn, stance. Read aloud: dread tableau.

lines: Seventy-one fours an aeon's lord; fourteen his day;
at day's end, worlds fire-burnt, worlds smoke-lulled,
all folk swift, flame-sped, in man's world ghost-pale stand.
l4.sanskrit_cite: caturyugānām ekasaptatyā manvantaram manvantaraiḥ caturdaśabhiḥ brāhmaṃ dinaṃ brahmadinānte kālāgnidagdhe lokatraye anyatra ca lokatraye dhūmaprasvāpite sarve janā vegavad agnipreritā janaloke pralayākalībhūya tiṣṭhanti
